description: This file defines an authentication service class, AuthService, that manages user signup, login, and JWT token verification using Supabase and JWT libraries. It handles user registration, authentication, token creation, and verification processes.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides methods for user registration, login, and JWT token validation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] signup_user(self, signup_data: SignupRequest)
methods.description: Registers a new user with Supabase, creates a user profile, and generates a JWT access token.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] login_user(self, login_data: LoginRequest)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with Supabase and returns a JWT token with user info.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] verify_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token and extracts user information if valid.

methods.name: _create_access_token(self, data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Generates a JWT token with specified data and expiry.

ctags.name: _create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^    def _create_access_token(self, data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None):$/

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^    async def login_user(self, login_data: LoginRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: signup_user
ctags.pattern: /^    async def signup_user(self, signup_data: SignupRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: verify_token
ctags.pattern: /^    async def verify_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
